style: Traditional Chinese ink-and-light-watercolor painting (水墨淡彩), loose sketch-like brushwork on warm aged rice paper (宣纸) texture, muted palette of ink greys with touches of indigo, ochre and a little vermilion, generous empty space (留白), a small vermilion seal in one lower corner. Absolutely no text, no calligraphy, no written characters, no border, no frame. Match the attached reference image's brushwork, paper tone, palette and seal placement exactly.

history-empty: A quiet scholar's desk with a closed thread-bound book, an ink stone, a brush resting on a brush rest and a small incense burner with a thin curl of smoke; very spare, mostly empty paper.
cast-backdrop: A tall vertical composition. Distant misty mountain peaks, drifting clouds and a pale sun, plus a few pine branches reaching in from the top-left corner, ALL of the scenery confined to the upper ~40% of the canvas. The scenery dissolves softly into mist so that the entire lower ~60% of the canvas is empty, plain warm rice paper with no objects (UI controls will sit there). One small vermilion seal near the right edge at about 40% of the height from the top, NOT at the bottom. Calm, airy, low-contrast, light washes only so overlaid text stays readable. No text, no calligraphy, no border, no frame.
app-icon: App icon: a bold single black ink-brush circle (ensō) on warm rice paper; inside it six horizontal bold brush strokes forming a hexagram, one stroke in vermilion; a small vermilion seal at the lower right. Simple, bold, readable at small sizes, full-bleed square, no transparency, no text.
header-spring: Early spring, plum blossoms on an old branch, a scholar with a staff crossing a small stone bridge over a stream, distant misty peaks.
header-summer: Summer lotus pond, a thatched pavilion on stilts, a figure reading inside, willows, soft haze.
header-autumn: Autumn river, a lone fisherman in a small boat, sparse red-ochre maple leaves on a cliff, a line of wild geese far away.
header-winter: Snow-covered pines and a hermit's hut on a mountain slope, a figure sweeping snow at the gate, pale sky.
header-night-moon: Night version for dark mode: the whole image dark, deep indigo-black night ink wash covering the paper, low overall brightness, silvery moonlight accents, muted vermilion seal, no bright cream areas. Full moon over a wide river, a small boat with a lantern, silhouetted far mountains.
header-night-stars: Night version for dark mode: the whole image dark, deep indigo-black night ink wash covering the paper, low overall brightness, silvery moonlight accents, muted vermilion seal, no bright cream areas. An ancient sage on a high stone terrace gazing up at a starry sky (仰观天文), an old pine silhouette.
header-night-temple: Night version for dark mode: the whole image dark, deep indigo-black night ink wash covering the paper, low overall brightness, silvery moonlight accents, muted vermilion seal, no bright cream areas. A mountain temple among dark pines, one warm lantern glow at a window, mist in the valley.
kb-origins: Legendary Fu Xi seated by a river observing a dragon-horse rising from the water with patterned dot markings on its back (河图), primordial landscape.
kb-yinyang: One mountain ridge half in sunlight, half in shadow, sun and pale moon both in the sky, a winding river between.
kb-bagua: A panoramic landscape containing heaven, earth, thunder clouds, wind in bamboo, water, fire (a distant beacon), mountain and a lake, in harmony.
kb-sixtyfour: A scholar's study by a window, bamboo-slip scrolls and stacked books on a low desk, brush and inkstone, garden outside.
kb-yao: A winding stone stairway of six landings climbing a steep mountain to a small pavilion at the top, a traveller on the lower steps.
kb-change: Clouds transforming over a waterfall that becomes a river, a crane taking flight; the feeling of flux.
kb-methods: Close still-life on a low table: three old bronze coins with square holes, a bundle of yarrow stalks, an incense burner with a thread of smoke.
kb-rules: A Song-dynasty academy hall among pines (like White Deer Grotto Academy), a teacher lecturing students seated on mats.
kb-tenwings: Confucius in old age reading a bamboo-slip scroll whose leather bindings have worn through (韦编三绝), lamplight, quiet room.
